name: Staff Mr Red (owns red minutes: collects failed merge-queue batches, claims each finding, records one mr_red_actions row per action before any act; C0 records observe rows only)

knobs.note: BH-9532 collector guard: bin/staff/mr-red.sh tick sets it to 1 for its own collector run. Without it bin/staff/mr-red-collect.sh and its sources print nothing, so bin/staff.sh tick-all claims nothing for mr-red. NOT settable from the control plane. The level, item cap, lookback and tick timeout are settings rows (staff.mr-red.level, .max_items_tick, .lookback_h, .tick_timeout_s), not lane knobs.
BH-9532 test seam: epoch seconds used as the clock of the lookback cutoff, only with HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 and only all-digit values. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam gate: MRR_NOW is honored only when this is 1 (the test harness sets it). Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.
